posts.title: Passport To Love
posts.feed_hook:
Sun on the water.
Passport on the table.

video_frames.hook:
Sun on
the water.
Passport out.

posts.instagram:
Sun on the water. Passport on the table.

On the cover of Passport To Love, a man in a cream knit shirt sits on a balcony with his chin in his hand, looking out over the ocean as the sun sets behind palm trees and hillside homes. A book titled Passport To Love rests on the table beside him. It's an Afrobeats and R&B album from Andre Soleil.

Romantic and made for travel, so put it on for date night or the trip you keep planning.

🌅 Passport To Love · Andre Soleil

The cover of Lounge Theory is all warm orange: a wooden turntable with a black record on the platter and the tone arm resting at the edge, under the title in tall cream letters. It's boom bap and soulful beats from Resonant Theory.

Relaxed and made for the lounge or the café, so put it on for a slow Sunday night at home.
